messages:
priya_csm: Heads-up — SpruceHealth sent over a 40-page vendor security questionnaire and asked for SOC2 evidence + KMS details by EOW. Link: https://spruce-docs.example.com/vendor-form. Any quick wins to get this back fast?

maria_cs: Thanks — can we offer a 30-minute security walkthrough? I can pull the latest SOC2 report and SSP.

vivian_security: We can provide SOC2 report + redacted SSP. Full access logs are off-limits, but we can supply aggregated query logs and a 7-day sample export. KMS: we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). Need: key ARN, desired rotation policy, and IAM roles.

ben_eng: I’ll prepare an "infrastructure summary" bundle: VPC egress config, recommended endpoint list, S3 server-side encryption settings, and a small README about network flow. Will drop in shared drive.

sam_se: Do we have a standard artifacts package for mid-market customers that avoids secrets? If yes, point me to it — otherwise I can assemble one from templates.

priya_csm: Proposed checklist to dispatch: [1] SOC2 report (PDF), [2] SSP (redacted), [3] data flow diagram, [4] KMS summary (supported modes + example ARNs), [5] retention & deletion policy excerpt, [6] pen test summary (high level), [7] named security contacts. I’ll be owner for collection & delivery.

vivian_security: Note re: EU residency question in the form — Spruce asked if customer data can be kept in EU. We can offer Redwood Private in EU regions or a DPA addendum clarifying processing locations. @legal-bot can you draft a short addendum?

legal-bot: On it. I’ll draft a single-paragraph residency addendum + DPA clause for subprocessors and get to you by EOD tomorrow. Also adding standard redaction guidance for SSP.

priya_csm: Spruce asked for contact for technical follow-up and a 30-min slot. I suggested tomorrow 10:00 PT or 15:00 PT. @spruce_rep — which works?

spruce_rep: 15:00 PT works for us. Please send calendar invite and a brief agenda (SOC2 overview, KMS options, DPA/residency).

ben_eng: Uploaded initial artifacts to: https://drive.redwood.com/spruce_evidence/. Files: soc2_2025.pdf (redacted), infra_summary.md, kms_modes.md. I’ll add an access README and note where we redacted IPs.

maria_cs: Great. Priya — I can take the walkthrough with Viv. I’ll review the form and flag any high-risk asks before the call so we don’t promise anything we can’t deliver.

priya_csm: Perfect. Action items: Ben — confirm drive perms + add README; Vivian — prepare redaction notes + KMS sample; Legal — draft DPA addendum; Maria — pre-read & risk flag. I’ll send invite for 15:00 PT.

vivian_security: Minor FYI — the vendor form asks for retention windows by data type. We keep embedding vectors for 90 days by default in hosted product; Dedicated/Private customers can configure via policy. Call note: have a short slide ready. :thumbsup:

priya_csm: Thanks team — will follow up after call with the packet we send to Spruce.

spruce_rep: Thanks all — looking forward to the walkthrough.
